name: gru953
description: Applies the GRU953 brand to anything written, designed or built: the Soaring Bird mark, the two-value Daybreak signature, the locked bilingual taglines, and the Apache-2.0 / PolyForm licence split. Generates marks, lockups, icon sets, social artwork and design tokens. Scaffolds a repository with the right licences, README and brand check. Reviews anything against the brand and WCAG 2.2 AA, naming the rule broken and the fix. সহজ প্রযুক্তি। সবার জন্য। · Simple technology. For everyone.
